name: Polynomial Primality Disguise
description: Replaces the explicit global product condition with a local, symmetric polynomial condition ($x^3 + y^3 - (xy)^2$ is prime) that evaluates to prime (5) iff the two labels in {1,2} are distinct, and non-prime (0 or 1) otherwise, completely hiding the bipartite graph structure behind a number-theoretic mask.
